set.body: Provider prerequisite for PLS Neuro bd-01M2B710PC2X01PPK133PDPHMV. Reuse reference raster kernel and native SurfaceRenderPlan without local consumer renderer. Stream strips at global pixel coordinates with no pick buffers; explicit render-only capability receipt, memory preflight suitable for3GiB applications, cooperative cancellation and sink failure. Full-frame vs joined-strip deterministic pixel oracle on JVM+JS, real SpikeB scenes after admission. Prior spike a89b299 / PLS issue bd-01M277KNZYE5RD49J49Q9PEW8T. Current main e071e83 predates admitted paired-camera a3ee73b; integration lineage must be settled before claiming same current-app scene semantics. Source-only until serialized machine grant.
set.title: Bounded render-only surface raster strips with preflight and cancellation
